strategy.viral_vs_stalled_reason: The channel stalls when the content is too short (22s) or the engagement is purely passive. Our 50s+ videos perform 2x better because they accumulate more absolute retention time. We are currently 'stalled' at the 3k view mark because we have 0 comments; the algorithm sees no 'community heat' to justify a 10k+ push.
strategy.engagement_diagnosis: The 'Wait for #1' and 'Did #2 Rob #1' gimmicks are officially dead for this audience. They are ignoring the bait. To fix the 0.000% comment rate, we must pivot from 'ranking' to 'verifying.' We need to challenge the viewer's logic or ask for a specific personal anecdote related to the visual.
strategy.peak_timing_insight: The 19:15 WAT window is our 'Golden Hour.' It perfectly captures the Nigerian evening peak while hitting the US East Coast at 2:15 PM (late lunch/afternoon slump) and the US West Coast at 11:15 AM (pre-lunch scroll). This dual-continent synchronization is why the US and Nigeria are our top two drivers.
strategy.ranking_tactic: The 'Logic-Defying Progression.' Instead of a subjective ranking, we will present 5 clips that get progressively more 'impossible' to explain, moving from 'Lucky' to 'Glitch in the Matrix.' This forces the viewer to debate the authenticity of the final clip in the comments.
